online_gate_a_c.c_scope: Per significant RTT/class cell, as prior gate implementation; also report global weighted agreement. No global average silently replaces a failing cell.

matched_probe_robustness_gate_a_c.c_scope: Per significant RTT/class cell, as prior gate implementation; also report global weighted agreement. No global average silently replaces a failing cell.

own_group_gate_b.interpretation: Report final class structure for both critics and both sampler repeats, together with all lambda>=30 observations. E1 class-difference significance was not separately registered/tested; no post-hoc choice among J10/J40 class point contrasts is made. This reports sampler-consistent class order, without proving that order correct. Lambda is not a visibility certificate. Online and offline target/BN paths differ; matched offline full arm isolates the loss-mask comparison.

post_hoc_support_alignment.interpretation: Original pooled E1 is observation/innovation-variance weighted, whereas retrospective critic probes approximately balance actors within class. The dominant positive-E1 actors have positive critic gradients despite negative pooled critic means. This identifies a composition problem in the proposed comparison, without proving all states correct or allowing post-hoc actor release. The innovation-versus-persistent-action estimand difference also remains.

limitations: No actor learning or frozen performance/CPU evaluation in L2A; no new accepted base, M1 remains unmet.
J10 innovation response and persistent-action Q derivative are different estimands. Their disagreement rejects the registered operational gate, not uniquely critic correctness.
Exploration latent offsets are logged; all formal rows have no clipping. Actor weights/Adam frozen but BN evolves, so the full policy is not frozen.
HAC120 and Holm16 are finite-sample approximations on six connections per RTT, one source seed. Cross-connection shared BN and nonstationarity remain limitations.
Final replay retains only last300k of514075 rows; startup states are evicted. Early snapshots queried on final replay are retrospective, not contemporaneous validation.
Offline paired loss intervention composes historical target duplicates deterministically and feeds paired Gaussian smoothing; it is not bit-exact online replay.
Both offline sampler repeats use the same source model and replay; not independent training seeds.
No complete TCP/history/exploration/TF queue resume or actor-release token was implemented.
